Why should I choose Foundations Marketing over Wix or Squarespace?

Because you don't need to do any of the work.

All you need to do is provide us with your content and an email address.

Your Content: All your text, high-quality photos, and service descriptions, which you submit through our questionnaire.

Email Address: You will need an email address to link to your calendar and to receive customer queries. You can use a free service like Google or Zoho, or purchase a business email.
What else do I need to make my website live?

Your £299 website includes personalising your chosen template and setting it up. To make it publicly visible (live), you will need to pay for:

A Domain Name: The website's address (e.g., yourbusiness.com).

Website Hosting: The server space where your website files live.

We handle the technical setup to connect it all once you have those two things.

What can I use as my booking system?

We highly recommend you look into third-party booking systems like Acuity, Calendly, or Square Appointments, as our templates easily integrate with all of them. Alternatively, if you want more control over who can book and prefer to chat with a potential client first, we can stick to query bookings where clients fill out a contact form to message you and book in after you speak to them.

The Downloadables are guides, checklists, and planning templates that help you prepare your business and content. You do not need them to start your website, but they are incredibly useful for busy solopreneurs who want help with content planning, setting up social media, or structuring their service packages.
What does a round of revisions mean?

A round of revision is a single set of feedback you share after reviewing the content we've uploaded into your website template of your choice.

Once the content is in place, you'll have the chance to review everything and send through one clear, combined list of changes, which we'll then update in one go. This helps keep the process simple, efficient, and on track.

A revision round is perfect for small refinements, such as:

–Tweaking wording or copy
–Swapping images
–Minor layout or formatting adjustments within the chosen template

It doesn't include bigger changes like new pages, structural updates, or switching templates after the upload has been completed.

We recommend gathering all feedback together before sending it through as additional revisions will be charged extra at 75GBP per revision
